text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...It throbs.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I can feel a new heat coursing through my body.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (This is exhilaration, and pure joy.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Meeting a formidable new rival. And my gratitude to them for dedicating their heart and soul to competing with me today—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Surely... my limits are still far beyond this――)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Miss Oguri—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Your running today... was amazing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's make the next race a great one too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, please do...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I'm back.
choice_data_list: Looks like you got a good feel for it.
Looks like you got a good feel for it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While it's frustrating that we didn't win,
we gained something far greater.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Their strength is beyond imagination.
And for that, I am truly delighted."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The rivals running ahead of me show me, like the dawn, that this is not yet my limit...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As long as they remain beloved goals and rivals—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There is no bound to the limits this body can surpass,
and the brilliance it emits, the trail of light it can trace,
shall become infinitely dazzling...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I have absolute certainty of it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when clashing head-on with a superior rival,
Mejiro Ardan's resolve does not waver.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far from it, she seems to have discovered her own potential
and is burning with even more fighting spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Can I—
ever reach heights great enough
to outshine them?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Your unwavering words are truly encouraging.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...With the Classic year nearing its end,
the battles against her rivals will only
become even fiercer from here on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might be best to take a breather before the next goal
and focus on taking her abilities
up another notch.
choice_data_list: Next, let's aim for the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "It's the classic royal road race to determine the strongest middle-distance runner of the spring, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sure a magnificent radiance will gather there once again.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to competing already.
I'm looking forward to competing already.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back and review today's performance right away.
I want to check Tamamo-san and Oguri-san's runs
one more time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, unable to contain her soaring excitement,
I hurried back to the academy together with Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And at almost the exact same time—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—This year's Tenno Sho (Autumn) was truly
a magnificent race!
The venue is still buzzing with excitement—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san... keeps getting stronger and stronger...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And yet... I...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...It's okay. I can become even stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (—No. I must become stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(So that when Chiyono O-san returns someday...
I will be worthy of being her rival...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—The Osaka Hai.
There, I will surely shine even brighter...!
